dataset.task: Forecast the next temperature and salinity profile (about 10 days ahead) from the three preceding profiles

models.name: Persistence
models.description: Next profile = the last profile (assumes no change).

models.name: Climatology (regional)
models.description: Long-term average profile of the whole Arabian Sea for that calendar month.

models.name: Climatology (local)
models.description: Long-term average for the same grid cell and calendar month.

models.name: Ridge
models.description: Linear regression on the 96 inputs (3 profiles x 32 values).

models.name: LightGBM
models.description: Gradient-boosted decision trees, one per output value.

models.name: GRU
models.description: Recurrent network that reads the three profiles in order.

models.name: Seq2Seq LSTM + attention
models.description: LSTM encoder-decoder that can focus on the most useful past profile.

models.name: DLinear
models.description: Trend + remainder decomposition with linear layers.

models.name: N-HiTS
models.description: Stacked MLP blocks working at different time resolutions.

models.name: TFT
models.description: Temporal Fusion Transformer: attention plus input selection.

models.name: Bi-LSTM (no physics loss)
models.description: Same network as FloatChat, trained on error only (ablation).

models.name: FloatChat PI-BiLSTM
models.description: 2-layer bidirectional LSTM with a TEOS-10 density-stability penalty (proposed).

chronological.label: Future years (2019-2026)
chronological.description: Trained on profiles up to 2016, validated on 2017-2018, tested on 2019-2026.

unseen_floats.label: Unseen floats
unseen_floats.description: Tested on floats never used in training or validation (all years).
